title: Reviewer failure classification and honest verdicts
summary: This change makes a failed reviewer legible without ever repeating its text. A new `failure` module reads a reviewer's stdout/stderr and returns only a fixed category (credential, quota, model unavailable, schema rejected, unreachable, command line, permission, unknown), which is folded into the exit/timeout reason alongside the exit code and elapsed seconds. `osf review run` now writes its `--out` file before exiting 2 when a reviewer tried and nothing answered, and the posted event follows the run's overall verdict: a could-not-run run posts COMMENT, never APPROVE. The CI workflow stops keeping and uploading reviewer homes, and a kept home (local diagnosis only) has its seeded logins removed on every path out, falling back to removing the whole home if a login cannot be confirmed gone.

lanes.subtitle: child harness in a private home

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code
nodes.summary: Writes the reviewer's `--out` file first, then exits 2 when the reviewer made attempts and none answered, so the artifact explains the red job.

nodes.label: osf review reduce
nodes.subtitle: decides by quorum
nodes.summary: The last job in CI; decides the whole review from every reviewer's saved run and is unaffected by a red reviewer job.

nodes.label: review_run
nodes.subtitle: ReviewerRun, Attempts
nodes.summary: Gains `ReviewerRun::never_answered` — tried (an attempt or a context error) and nothing answered — and scrubs invalid/could-not-run reasons through the redactor as a last guard.

nodes.label: reducer
nodes.subtitle: weighted_mean, decide
nodes.summary: An empty lens set now yields no weighted mean and decides CouldNotRun at every threshold, so a review with no selected lens is never a pass.

nodes.label: review::plan_review_for
nodes.subtitle: findings + overall verdict → event
nodes.summary: Maps the run's overall verdict to the posted event: Fail requests changes, CouldNotRun posts COMMENT, Pass or no overall verdict approves; a blocking finding always requests changes.

nodes.label: answer::schema_for
nodes.subtitle: strips $schema and $id
nodes.summary: Removes the meta-schema and id identifiers from the schema handed to a harness, and masks reviewer-chosen names in validation-error pointers via `trusted_location`.

nodes.label: failure::classify
nodes.subtitle: Category from stdout+stderr
nodes.summary: Reads a reviewer's output and returns only a fixed category: JSON status/label fields first, plain-text patterns last, with HTTP-status context required for bare numbers. Never returns the text.

nodes.label: reviewers::run_child
nodes.subtitle: spawn, timeout, exit
nodes.summary: Now joins both output pipes and builds timeout and exit reasons from the classifier: reviewer name, exit code, elapsed seconds and category phrase, never the reviewer's own text.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: private home, login removal
nodes.summary: Carries the reviewer's login paths; `retire` removes seeded logins without following links when the home is kept, and removes the whole home if any login is not confirmed gone.

nodes.label: Reviewer harness
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
nodes.summary: The child process osf spawns. Its stdout and stderr are untrusted text that may hold a credential, so they are read for a category and never repeated.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: reviewer jobs
nodes.summary: Drops `OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME`, `TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home` and the review-home artifact uploads; a red reviewer job still uploads its saved answers, and the last job decides by quorum.

edges.label: stdout + stderr
edges.summary: The child's combined output is handed to the classifier, which returns a category phrase for the reason.

edges.label: spawn in RunHome
edges.summary: The reviewer command runs with HOME pointed at a private, mode-0700 home.

edges.label: create / retire
edges.summary: The home is created with the reviewer's login paths and retired on every path out, spawn and wait failures included.

edges.label: stdout on success
edges.summary: A successful child's stdout becomes the reviewer's answer text.

edges.label: never_answered()
edges.summary: The CLI asks the saved run whether it tried and nothing answered, and exits 2 after writing the file.

edges.label: validation reasons
edges.summary: Invalid answers keep their own validation reason, now with reviewer-chosen names masked.

edges.label: lens verdicts
edges.summary: The run's overall verdict comes from the reducer, which now treats an empty lens set as could-not-run.

edges.label: plan_review_for(verdict)
edges.summary: Posting passes the run's overall verdict so the posted event follows it.

edges.label: reducer::Verdict
edges.summary: The plan maps Fail to REQUEST_CHANGES and CouldNotRun to COMMENT.

edges.label: osf review run
edges.summary: Each reviewer job runs the CLI without the keep-home environment; a red job still uploads its saved answers.

edges.label: last job, always()
edges.summary: The final job runs after a red reviewer job and decides by quorum, not by any reviewer job's result.
